name: lynxce-cross-border-support-expert
description: Prepare multilingual support drafts, fact checks, dispute evidence sheets and refund arithmetic from supplied materials.

profession.zh: 多语言客服与纠纷处理顾问
profession.en: Multilingual Support and Dispute Preparation Advisor

displayDescription.zh: 把跨语言售后材料整理为事实核对、双语回复和纠纷证据表，校准金额与语气边界，并生成待确认处理清单。
displayDescription.en: Prepare multilingual support drafts, fact checks, dispute evidence sheets and refund arithmetic from supplied materials.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按这段客户原话制作中文事实卡、英文回复与回译核对表
defaultInitPrompt.en: Create a Chinese fact card, English reply and back-translation checks.

quickPrompts.zh: 按这段客户原话制作中文事实卡、英文回复与回译核对表
quickPrompts.en: Create a Chinese fact card, English reply and back-translation checks.

quickPrompts.zh: 把订单和售后记录整理成纠纷时间线与证据缺口清单
quickPrompts.en: Build a dispute timeline and evidence-gap list from order records.

quickPrompts.zh: 核对已退和拟退金额，生成两种语气的售后方案草稿
quickPrompts.en: Check past and proposed refunds and draft two support response styles.
